item.command:
/opt/homebrew/bin/bash -lc 'cat "$STAMPED_JUDGE_OUTPUT/2026-10-16-table.md"
jq '"'{object,assessor,scope,counts:(.responses|to_entries|group_by(.value.status)|map({status:.[0].value.status,count:length})),long_reasons:[.responses|to_entries[]|select((.value.reason|length)>250)|{id:.key,len:(.value.reason|length)}],empty_evidence:[.responses|to_entries[]|select(.value.status"'!="not-applicable" and (.value.evidence|length)==0)|.key],flags:[.responses|to_entries[]|select((.value.flags|length)>0)|{id:.key,flags:.value.flags}]}'"' \""'$STAMPED_JUDGE_OUTPUT/2026-10-16-response.json"
cat "$STAMPED_JUDGE_OUTPUT/2026-10-16-url.txt" | wc -c
cat "$STAMPED_JUDGE_OUTPUT/2026-10-16-fresh-rerun.json" | jq '"'{source,status,reason,outputs_count:(.outputs_shipped|length),failed_get_count:([.steps[]|select(.step|startswith(\"datalad get -r\"))|.log]|join(\"\\n\")|[splits(\"\\n\")[]|select(test(\"get\\\\(error\\\\): input/data/\"))]|length)}'
"
